# Abdelkerim Dassi

> AI engineer and AI Team Lead at 1morething Studio (Tunis, Tunisia). Builds production RAG, LLM agents, agent-evaluation tasks for frontier models, and edge computer vision on NVIDIA Jetson. Open to full-time AI / ML engineering roles with relocation to the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), France and the EU, the UK, or the US. Needs an employer-sponsored work visa; 21-day notice. Also takes remote freelance projects.

Arabic (native), English (C1), French (C1), basic German. In AI since 2021 (internships during engineering school), full-time since 2025. National Engineer Degree in Data Science, ESPRIT (2025). Four NVIDIA DLI certifications.

## Work with measured results

- [Absar case study](https://abdelkerimdassi.com/case-studies/edge-cctv): 11 on-device SOP checks on NVIDIA Jetson, live in a coffee chain in Riyadh since Sep 2026. 17x faster inference from a GPU benchmark he ran; cup-detector precision 0.875 to 0.992; milk-detector precision 12% to 83%; hairnet false flags 3.7% to 0.2%.
- [SheGrows case study](https://abdelkerimdassi.com/case-studies/arabic-rag): WhatsApp RAG assistant for women farmers in Egypt, built for FAO. He built the Egyptian-dialect retrieval layer and expert feedback loop; 15K+ questions answered in production.
- [Experience and projects](https://abdelkerimdassi.com/work): AI Team Lead at 1morething Studio (owns the AI roadmap for every product); LegalTech on-premise Arabic OCR for a ministry (45x faster OCR); ~40 agentic evaluation tasks for Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5 and Opus 4.6 (~80% accepted); Qirat, a solo-built crypto decision desk; earlier roles at Qualipro, D2D Analytics, NTT DATA Munich and Silver Brain AI Zurich.
